notes.title: The Final Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
At last, the final update is here. It took a lot longer to implement due to the new addition to my family but I powered through it and finally finished the update. 

Here is what is new in the update:

Complete overhaul of the interaction system (No pointing laser to pick up items, simple look at item's direction is good enough).
Much smoother controls
Completely new "map", store and blacksmith.
Massive optimization to boost FPS.
Some bug fixes, I forgot to keep track of.

I am excited to hear your opinion about the new update. 

I just want to make sure I communicate this, while this is the last "major" update, it won't be the last "patch" if there are any bugs discovered, I will fix those.

 I really appreciate your patience and thank you for your support, NPCs

notes.title: Delivery Box Update
notes.content:
Hello NPCs,
 Implemented a feature which quite a few of you requested. One button click delivery. And some bug fixes.

Features:
[list]
[*] Added an upgrade upon purchase of all items will be delivered in box with a button. Basically there is going to be a button you press it all items will be in your inventory.
[*] Changed the button for opening a door to a lever because some of you accidentally pressed it in the middle of the hot negotiations with customers. Which caused all customers to leave your store making you doubt your decision of purchasing this game. You probably will still doubt your decision of purchasing this game but... less.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you reached the max level and didn't get your SP reward to buy some updates.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you reached the max level and reloaded the game then had to listen to the congratulation you leveled up ceremony sound every time you sold anything.
[/list]

[h2]Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a panel which will show what anvil is registering and a potential weapon all that metal will turn into. So, no more pikachu face when your metal doesn't turn into something.

notes.title: Floating Islands of Nucifera
notes.content:
In light of countless requests to make a non VR Shop Keep Game Odooh Games Announcing another game called Floating Islands of Nucifera. Its a fantasy open-world shopkeep game, where you can unlock quests, summon champions to slaughter monsters in turn-based combat, take loot back to sell in your store, and haggle with customers over the cost. Please wishlist it and share your thoughts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1494650/Floating_Islands_of_Nucifera/

PS. Announcement of Nucifera doesn't mean I am abandoning RPG NPC Simulator, I am still working on it.

notes.title: Open Door Button and some bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello NPCs,
 I believe I did not communicate this properly, but I've been working on a big update for this game. I am experimenting with different styles of combat system. I think I found a good system to go with, it fits the gameplay quite well. That is the main reason I haven't published any changes. But looks like there was a game breaking bug. So I am pushing a patch for that.

The patch includes:

[list]
[*] Open Door button, I know some of you struggled to open the door manually so I added a button for it.
[*] Customers tend to forget why they came in to your store and just stared at your item. I fixed their memory, so hopefully they know what they are doing. 
[*] UI Laser now allows you pick up dropped items by customers.  
[/list]

I think there are some minor bugs with blacksmith, I will fix those then get back to combat system.

The combat system will come soon and I think its going to be fun.

notes.title: Comfort Update
notes.content:
Hello NPCs,
 I just published a Comfort Update. As was shown in the [url=https://trello.com/b/zRsIImbn/rpg-npc-simulator]Trello Roadmap[/url] this was going to be the first update. However, some of the promised features was postponed to next update.

[h1]Here are the update notes and descriptions:[/h1]

    Added furniture section to the store. Now you can decorate second floor with some fancy furniture. Not only furniture serve as a decoration but also they give you buffs (someone suggested this on trello thank you for that). Like for example, buying a bed, not only it serves you as something to lay down on and waste your life but it also grants you a chance to skip a theif raid. So decorate away.

[h2]Changes/Reworks:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a feature to move shelves back to the inventory because some players misplaced it by an inch and their OCD kicked in.  (same feature applies to furniture).
[*] Reworked Pricing Items UI - now its a one line per item, instead of two items squished in one line which later caused an issue where you couldn't actually price an item. 
[*] Made some changes to the items delivery timer, lower level items now take a lot  quicker to deliver, because they are cheap and no one care about them.
[*] Moved customer negotiating UI above their head because it was getting stuck between shelves and caused some issues. Oh and customers tend to negotiate more often.
[*] Improved the saving algorithm, to place your items back to where they were when you left the game, oh and it works 90% of the time, the other 10 it messes up. I will fix the fix later. (although it won't work the first time you load the game after the update.)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where closing the store caused customer to not show up until restart (this is actually a fix of a fix, because last time I implemented a fix which caused this issue)
[*] Fixed an attitude of customers, they no longer show up when doors are locked.
[*] Fixed (I think?) the bug where sold weapons were still showing up after loading.
[*] Fixed a bug where event items didn't get their chance of sale bonus.
[*] Fixed a bug where a lot of customers swarm in when you open your fully stocked shop. I guess I readjusted it, they still swarm just... less.
[*] Fixed a bug where leaving your bow at the door stopped thieves but did not remove the "feature" of stabbing thieves with an arrow, kind of realistic so I am keeping it.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and support, keep those feedback coming, it helps me to improve this game.

notes.title: RPG NPC Simulator Roadmap
notes.content:
Since this game is in early access it is only fair for you to know what I have planned for this game. I am also sharing trello link which you can follow and comment on. In there you can see what I am working on and what is coming. Keep in mind the list could expand (based on suggestions) but won't shrink.

I have five major updates planned for this game, firth one will be experimental(meaning it might not make it to the final game if the feedback from players is not good or if it's too big to be an update).

Comfort Update, Town Update Part 1, Town Update Part 2, Blacksmith Update and Adventure Mode. (see details in trello)

Keep in mind bug fixes and patches will take priority. As of now I am focused on fixing bugs and getting the game into stable shape, after which I start estimating release day for each update.

https://trello.com/b/zRsIImbn/rpg-npc-simulator

(There is a pinned discussion version of this)

Once again thank you for your support NPCs
